content: Ywan Un'düümà u nsye a ipɔl
Utaaŋ alan, Ywan Un'düümà kàyàmɛnà u nsye a ipɔl a Yuday mulɔŋ naa:
« Làbuul mpem abɛ, ntɔn Imwol a du kye tsütsü! »
Ywan awà wà mbuur kàsam ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay utaaŋ kàtɛɛnà nde naa:

content.text: « Ndaa mwɛy yàmusaa in'kwɛŋ u nsye a ipɔl:

content: Ywan kàbwäärà ipfɛy a in'kà a Kamɛl anà un'kab a ibaan a ntsür u lɔŋ ande. Nde kàdyee mpay anà bwey a ndwaŋ.
Abun Yɛlusàlɛm, Yuday lanswà, anà un'tà a Yɔrdan bàkyeenà akà nde.
Ba bàkyeyà man'be aba u mii a baar anà Ywan kadümà u Yɔrdan.
Mpal kàmɛn nde naa Amfarisi anà Asadusi mbɔɔn bàyee akà nde ntɔn muwal ndüümà, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mbil a iyäy! Nà kàlalɔŋ mutiin nkyɛl a Nzam ayà iyà?
Làswɛŋ unsà nsyääl abɛ naa bɛ lan'buul mpem,
anà twon lan'tɛn u mpem abɛ naa: "Abàlam wà nkaa abi!" Ntɔn mɛ alakyään naa Nzam kan'kwo mutwey ikyee a Abàlam u nkɔŋ yi!
Fà itaan nkwar yà tsütsü mutsul in'te kun'swɛy: un'te wanswà mpa afàbɔr imbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ, bàkyer asun'tsul, waa bàsun'tɔɔm u mbaa.
« Mɛ, mɛ in'kàladümà kan'dà ntɔn mbuul a mpem. Wɛɛ mbuur awà ayà ungö a mɛ kàman'lyaŋ u ngwal: mɛ in'kwe anki musɔɔl idyäär ande. Nde, nde asàladümà u Dweelà In'kyɛɛl anà u mbaa.
Nde we anà impye u kɔɔ ande ntɔn mukɔɔm blɛ. Nde asàsà imbɛŋ uboo a ikɔr, wɛɛ un'lɛŋ nde asàtɔɔm u mbaa mpa isàdim akà ikikye. »
Abun, Yɛsu kàfü Ngalilɛ, waa kàyàkɔlà u Yɔrdan akà Ywan Un'düümà u ngyäl a Yɔrdan, ntɔn nde kun'dümà.
Wɛɛ Ywan kàmɛn ube, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mɛ, mɛ in'làkwo muyà akà ngye, ntɔn ngye an'pɛ ndüümà, wɛɛ ngye, ngye afàyà akà mɛ! »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Wɛy ya ikäl abà apanà, ntɔn yà ubwaŋ naa bi ikwey balàbal lanswà. » Abun, Ywan waa kàkyey.
Pa kàwɛl nde ndüümà, Yɛsu laa kàtoo nde kan'dà. Taaŋ nsil la du waa làyaanà, nde kàmɛn Dweelà a Nzam wàmuyàtyà akà nde asànaa nkokà.
Le, ndaa mwɛy yàfü du, waa yàtɛn naa: « Wawà wà Mwan amɛ wà nkween. Mpem amɛ yanswà ye amu nde. »
